jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Mango production manual
kalro_guide_ref: KALRO Mango production guide + HCD export standards

varieties.name: Apple
varieties.supplier_notes: Most-planted Kenyan mango; sweet, fibreless; local market dominant.

varieties.name: Tommy Atkins
varieties.supplier_notes: Main export variety; ships well; firmer flesh.

varieties.name: Kent
varieties.supplier_notes: Premium export; sweeter than Tommy; late season.

timeline_template.description_en: Mark planting holes 8m x 8m for grafted trees. Dig 60cm cubed; mix soil + 2 tins manure.
Plant grafted seedling at nursery depth. Stake to prevent wind damage.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mche kina sawa na kitalu. Simika nguzo.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100g DAP per hole, well-mixed below the rootball.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka gramu 100 za DAP kwa shimo.

timeline_template.description_en: Water 20L per tree every 10 days for first 6 months if no rain.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwagilia lita 20 kila siku 10 kwa miezi 6.

timeline_template.description_en: Mulch the basin 50cm radius around trunk. Don't pile against bark.
timeline_template.description_sw: Funika kuzunguka mti urefu cm 50. Usigusane na gome.
Weka gramu 250 za NPK kwa mti.

timeline_template.description_en: Train to 3-4 main scaffold branches. Remove low branches < 60cm from ground.
timeline_template.description_sw: Fanya matawi 3-4 ya msingi. Ondoa matawi chini ya cm 60.

timeline_template.description_en: Year 2 NPK: 500g per tree, split 2 doses.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mwaka 2: gramu 500 za NPK kwa mti, dosi 2.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for mango fruit fly + thrips at flowering of year 2-3.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya mango fruit fly + thrips wakati wa maua.

timeline_template.description_en: First commercial fruit at year 2-3 (grafted). Pick at mature-green stage for export.
timeline_template.description_sw: Matunda ya kwanza mwaka 2-3 (kupandikiza). Vuna yakiwa magumu kabla ya kuiva.
timeline_template.tip_en: Apple: pick when shoulder fills + skin lightens. Tommy: hard fruit, 12% Brix.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Apple: vuna mabega yakijaa. Tommy: tunda gumu.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Export A: 300-500g, no blemishes, 1 stem cm. Local B: 200-300g or minor flaws.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: 13°C optimal. Refrigeration below 10°C causes chilling injury.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: 13°C ndiyo bora. Friji chini ya 10°C huharibu.
